snippet.title: Chomp Garden - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Chomp Garden is a bite-sized puzzle adventure in a garden full of deceptively cute plants. Play as a tiny glowing lamp and shape them with your light to make your way deeper and find your pup.

Steam Link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4457150
